metadata.description: Plugins for building a portable PKM knowledge graph from MOCs, atomic notes, meaningful internal links, tags, and companion coaching assets.

plugins.name: create-domain-moc
plugins.description: Create or revise one domain Map of Content that defines scope and provides descriptive navigation to atomic notes.

plugins.name: create-atomic-note
plugins.description: Create or revise one reusable knowledge pattern and connect it to a domain Map of Content with practical signals, learning, constraints, links, and tags.

plugins.name: create-coaching-note
plugins.description: Create or revise a coaching companion with teaching, discovery questions, an exercise, adoption practices, progress signals, and resistance support.

plugins.name: create-obsidian-marp-slides
plugins.description: Create or update one domain's Obsidian Marp presentation as a connected system of atomic patterns, practices, relationships, application, and optional coaching companions.
